Fresh strict export embeds actual commit/tree/diff in every graph and COMPLETE and rechecks source. Unchanged selected coordinates do not make source-bearing output bytes identical after commit change.

Requires graph/COMPLETE hash/source equality, embeds source in license-evidence and each BOM; Parlor metadata.version equals commit. Reviewed renderer has fresh output/POM capture, not an offline old-receipt rebinding mode.

Exact9-key binding and4-key clean source; full producer snapshot equality, current bound runner, graph/report source identity, C14 inputs and consumed closure.
